standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a finite union of nowhere dense subsets is nowhere dense
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 4325)
standard_prerequisites.use: Combines the closures of the locally closed pieces of the complement.

core_obligations: Reduce to the closed case: replacing the space by the closure of the subset makes it dense, so it suffices to exhibit a dense open inside it (proof lines 4319-4321)
Complement: the complement is a finite union of locally closed subsets and is nowhere dense (proof lines 4322-4325)
Produce the dense open: the union of the closures of those pieces is nowhere dense, so the complement of that union is a dense open contained in the subset (proof lines 4326-4327)
proof_roadmap: 把 X 换成闭包(E) ⇒ 不妨设 E 稠密。
补集 T 是有限个局部闭集之并且无处稠密；各 T_i 在其闭包 Z_i 中开稠密 ⇒ Z_i 在 X 中无处稠密。
Z = ∪ Z_i 无处稠密 ⇒ X ∖ Z 是含于 E 的稠密开集。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a dense constructible subset of a topological space contains a dense open subset (author lemma at source lines 4312-4317, label lemma-dense-in-constructible). The proof (source lines 4319-4328) reduces to the dense case, writes the complement as a finite union of locally closed nowhere dense pieces, combines their closures with the finite-union statement and takes the complement of that union (proof lines 4319-4327). The reduction and the finite-union step are the content. H3.
